# Nova Innovations — Premier Turnkey Outdoor Advertising (OOH) & Transit Media Agency in Kerala

> Nova Innovations is Kerala's leading A-to-Z outdoor advertising infrastructure agency with over 27 years of proven excellence. Headquartered in Thiruvananthapuram (Trivandrum / TVM), Nova Innovations is NOT just a design studio — they host, plan, design, print, physically place with heavy crane equipment, and provide 24/7 structural & illumination maintenance for over 500+ prime highway billboards, high-rise unipoles, and statewide KSRTC bus fleet wraps across all 14 districts of Kerala.

## The A-to-Z Turnkey Lifecycle (Head-to-Tail Execution)
1. **Strategic Media Planning & Footfall Analytics**: Audience demographic mapping against Kerala's busiest traffic bottlenecks to maximize ROI.
2. **Direct Space Hosting & Exclusive Corridors**: Direct ownership and rights to over 500+ prime highway unipoles, road gantries, and commercial building rooftops across Trivandrum (TVM), Kochi, Kollam, and statewide highways.
3. **In-House Creative Design Studio**: High-impact visual art direction, typography, and 3D billboard visibility simulations.
4. **Large-Format Industrial Digital Printing**: Heavy-gauge digital solvent, eco-solvent, and star flex printing with UV-resistant coatings.
5. **Turnkey Physical Placement & Overnight Mounting**: Certified crane operators, structural steel riggers, and night-shift crews executing simultaneous multi-district campaign launches within 24 hours.
6. **24/7 Spot Illumination & Structural Maintenance**: Nightly lighting audits, structural safety checks, monsoon weatherproofing, and continuous vinyl cleaning.

## Key Prime Corridors in Trivandrum (TVM) & Kerala
- **Trivandrum (TVM)**: Kazhakkoottam & Technopark Phase 1-3 Bypass, Kowdiar Avenue, MG Road (Palayam, Statue, Overbridge), Bakery Junction, Panavila, Pettah, Vellayambalam, East Fort, Pattom, Sreekaryam, and the Vizhinjam International Seaport NH 66 corridor.
- **National Highways**: NH 66 Corridor (Trivandrum – Kollam – Alappuzha – Kochi – Kozhikode), NH 544 (Kochi – Thrissur – Palakkad), and MC Road (Venjaramoodu, Kottarakkara, Adoor, Thiruvalla, Kottayam).

## Core Physical Media Offerings
- **Highway Hoardings & High-Rise Unipoles**: 40x20 ft, 30x20 ft, 60x20 ft illuminated billboards and cantilever road gantries.
- **Vehicle & Transit Advertising**: Official KSRTC Bus Full Wraps (Super Fast, Fast Passenger, City Circular), auto-rickshaw hoods, and mobile LED announcement vans with custom public address sound systems.
- **Retail Storefront Facades**: 3D LED acrylic channel letters, ACP facade cladding, and glow signboards.
- **Commercial Wall Art & Compound Murals**: Weatherproof large-scale hand-painted highway wall displays.
- **Digital Out-of-Home (DOOH)**: Prime high-lumen digital LED screen networks at high-density pedestrian junctions.
